name: כְּנַעֲנָה
summary: Borne by the father of Zedekiah, the prophet of Ahab's court who made horns of iron, promised victory over Aram, and struck Micaiah on the cheek (1Ki 22:11, 24; 2Ch 18:10, 23); and by a Benjamite, son of Bilhan (1Ch 7:10). The name is כְּנַעַן “Canaan” with the ending ־ָה, either a feminine form, “Canaanite”, or the ending of direction, “toward Canaan”, as in אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן (Gen 11:31); scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Zedekiah son of כְּנַעֲנָה made himself horns of iron.”
The sons of Bilhan: “Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, וּכְנַעֲנָה, Zethan …”.
“To go אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן”: the ending of direction, one reading of the name's last letter.

note: Drafted 2026-11-19 with kana. Both TIPNR records spell the name כְּנַעֲנָה. Whether the ending is feminine or directional is open; neither reading is fixed by a verse.
